{{Quote|Five battleships have been detected, Magister.''"<br />"''Ahead of schedule.''"<br />"''Perhaps your enemies received intelligence that their attack plan had been compromised.''"<br />"''A sound speculation, FourDee.|11-4D and Darth Plagueis|<ref name="DP" />}}
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] was '''devastated''' by a [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear]] attack that was staged by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his rival, [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IBC]] kingpin Hego Damask, alter ego of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. The attack destroyed Plagueis' residence on the moon and wiped out his entire contingent of [[Sun Guard]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. However, Plagueis himself—to the great astonishment of the few who knew of the attack (especially Veruna)—evaded death during the bombardment, having been forewarned of the attack, and then rescued, by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="DP" />

When Jabba advised Veruna of Damask's survival, the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Naboo monarch]] promptly [[Eriadu Trade Summit|abdicated]] his throne and fled with his loyal bodyguard to what he believed to be the protective fortress of his [[Earl of Vis/Legends|family's]] ancient [[Earl of Vis' castle|castle]] in Naboo's [[Western Reaches (Naboo)|Western Reaches]]. But the Sith Lord had already sworn swift vengeance upon Veruna, [[Alexi Garyn]]'s [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, and the [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|other]] [[Bando Gora/Legends|conspirators]] who'd made an attempt on his life, and none were safe.<ref name="DP" />
